parameters.name: NewComments
parameters.description:
The new description of the RAM user.

The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: NewDisplayName
parameters.description:
The new display name of the RAM user.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: NewEmail
parameters.description:
The new email address of the RAM user.

>  This parameter applies only to the China site (aliyun.com).

parameters.name: NewMobilePhone
parameters.description:
The new mobile phone number of the RAM user.

Format: \<Country code>-\<Mobile phone number>.

>  This parameter applies only to the China site (aliyun.com).

parameters.name: NewUserName
parameters.description:
The new username of the RAM user.

The username must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username of the RAM user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram update-user --user-name zhangq0000 --new-user-name xiaoq0000 --new-display-name xiaoq0000 --new-mobile-phone 86-18600000000 --new-email xiaoq0000@example.com --new-comments This_is_a_cloud_computing_engineer. --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram UpdateUser --region cn-hangzhou --UserName zhangq0000 --NewDisplayName xiaoq0000 --NewMobilePhone '86-18600000000' --NewUserName xiaoq0000 --NewEmail 'xiaoq0000@example.com' --NewComments 'This_is_a_cloud_computing_engineer.'
